data.exact_reserve_text: Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience. Prior to the external RITC transaction being concluded, liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k, taking the total due from members and the Lloyd's Central Fund (LCF) to GBP 45,158k, this amount was settled during the financial year.

prior_year_events.event_name: Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves
prior_year_events.impact_description: uncertainty over these reserves led to the 2007 underwriting year remaining open and subsequently requiring strengthening of liabilities by GBP 5,833k prior to closure.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves, totaling GBP 126.789 million, representing 23.0% of opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by worse than anticipated loss experience across all years of account. A specific strengthening of GBP 5.833 million was noted for the 2007 underwriting year due to uncertainty over Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves, which was settled by members upon closure of the year.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience.
uncertainty over Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, summing the changes in cumulative estimates for underwriting years 2011-2014. The 2007 and 2013 year-of-account closures also indicate adverse development, with members settling GBP 45.157m and GBP 41.292m respectively, but these are net figures and not directly comparable to the gross triangle calculation.
